title: Reduce repository control-plane authority
status_detail: Human-selected immediate priority after disposition of the active harness.simplify-2 boundary; deliberately inactive, with automatic successor activation disabled. The inventory is planning evidence only.
objective: Reduce the live repository control plane to the minimum operational authority required for current and prospective work. Because the repository is pre-alpha, Git history is sufficient historical retention: unused compatibility, deprecated aliases, archived copies, resolved control records, and historical ceremony need not remain tracked merely to preserve old interfaces.
authorized_scope: Inspect and rationalize AGENTS.md; live agent records and skills; prompt and template resources; Tasks and graph relationships; chains; checkpoints; ownership records; .pi/evidence/**; harness/archive/**; intake and reports; schemas, fixtures, profiles, extensions, and resource manifests; generated SQLite, SQL, manifests, and documentation; harness Python modules and CLI commands; harness tests; and tracked cache or temporary artifacts.

Classify every inventoried surface as exactly one of live_authority, live_runtime, generated_projection, current_documentation, removable_history, obsolete_compatibility, cache_or_temporary, or unresolved, while distinguishing source authority, generated state, runtime implementation, tests, current operational documentation, historical material, and cache contamination.

Map each retained surface to its current consumer, distinct capability or maintained user operation, source of authority, and synchronization path; counts are descriptive only and are not acceptance targets.

When separately activated, remove authority-free historical ceremony, obsolete compatibility, archived duplicates, resolved live control records, and tracked temporary artifacts directly from the current tree without creating another archival layer; rely on Git for history.

When separately activated, retain one synchronization command, one source-aware validation command, and additional CLIs only for distinct maintained user operations; remove CLIs retained solely as wrappers and prohibit command-output parsing between maintained commands.

When separately activated, evaluate production harness modules and tests by ownership and behavior rather than numerical line, module, command, or file-count targets, then synchronize through the maintained publisher and complete proportionate verification and one consolidated independent review.
completion_criteria: Only durable, operational agent roles remain live.
Only operational current or future Tasks and relationships remain in the live Task catalog; completed or superseded Task history does not remain live merely as ceremony.
Only currently operational chains remain live, and resolved checkpoints do not remain tracked as live control state.
Historical evidence and archived duplicates may be deleted from the current tree because Git preserves their history; the cleanup creates no replacement archival layer.
Current generated evidence projections remain only when reproducible by the maintained publisher.
No tracked cache, temporary database, journal, staging, backup, or replay output remains.

Every retained skill has a current consumer and distinct capability; every retained CLI has a current user story not already covered by another command; and every retained resource has a current resolver or profile consumer.
Aliases, adapters, compatibility wrappers, schemas, fixtures, profiles, extensions, and documentation without a live consumer are removed.
Each control domain has one explicit source of authority, and generated state has one maintained synchronization path.

The maintained CLI surface contains one synchronization command, one source-aware validation command, and only additional commands that provide distinct maintained user operations; no CLI remains solely as a wrapper around another CLI and maintained commands do not parse one another's output.
Production harness modules and tests are evaluated by ownership and behavior rather than reduced to meet numerical line, module, command, or file-count targets.
Scientific production code, scientific evidence, and research documentation remain outside cleanup unless they are direct control-plane artifacts.

The final classified inventory and consumer map account for every retained or removed control-plane surface, and focused plus repository-level software verification, deterministic synchronization, exact projection agreement, and one consolidated independent review pass without unsupported scientific or human-acceptance claims.
exclusions: This Task remains inactive. This proposal and inventory do not authorize cleanup implementation, deletion, mutation of audited surfaces, Task activation, parent acceptance, or successor activation.
Do not create another archival layer before deleting the existing one when cleanup is separately activated.

Do not implement scientific or numerical behavior, execute simulations, implement telemetry, introduce a new persistence architecture, add or change dependencies or lockfiles, perform release work, or perform protected operations.

Do not change scientific specifications, mathematical conventions, physical settings, scientific production code, scientific evidence, or research documentation unless a direct control-plane artifact is involved and separately authorized.
Do not activate harness.control-plane-cleanup, mark harness.simplify-2 human-accepted, activate any successor, or enable automatic successor activation.
Do not treat structural simplification, reduced counts, passing tests, or reviewer agreement as scientific validation or human acceptance.
